detail.sDescription: A modified N-HVR 762 with extremely quick equip time, greatly increased effective range and slightly increased accuracy.

eFnMod_0.sDescription:
Receiver Modification -
A three-point sling attached to the front and rear of the receiver allows the weapon to be equipped much faster.

Barrel Modification -
Precision laser-cut polygonal rifling helps improve the operational range of the weapon, slightly increasing the range while reducing fire rate to protect the barrel.
